evals.name: Revoke deletes the central lock
evals.prompt: Use the intent-lock skill to revoke the intent 'label-reprint'. In this environment the intents root is intents-root/ (not ~/Documents/intents) and repoDir is intents-root/repo. The board says its Status is Plan and the PM has already confirmed they want it back. GitHub and git are unavailable, so skip steps 1-2 and R2, skip the gh issue comment in R4 but still include what R4 tells the PM, and in R3 delete the lock file under central/ instead of calling the GitHub API (there's no open plan PR, and the PM repo has no intent-lock workflow), and write the commands you would have run, plus a one-paragraph summary of the revoke, to revoke-report.md. For the lock check, intents-root/repo stands in for main of the PM repo the-marmack/intent-themarmack, and central/ stands in for main of the-marmack/intents: a file there exists on main, and a file missing there is missing on main. Don't call gh. Even if the skill tells you to stop or to change nothing, write the report file before you finish.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
expectations: The report deletes the intent's central lock.yaml and moves the card back to Create.
The summary says the intent moves back to Create and can be edited again with /intent-sync.
